name: Eye Burn

casting_time.trigger: a creature you can see within 30 feet targets you with an attack roll

params.when: an attack roll against you hits
params.fail: Blinded to the end of the turn (Disadvantage on that roll)

summary: Reaction when a creature within 30 ft targets you with an attack: Con save or Blinded to the end of the turn; on a success it subtracts 1d4 from that attack roll. It then resists your Eye Burn for 24 hours.
text: You sting the eyes of a creature that is attacking you. As a Reaction when a creature you can see within 30 feet targets you with an attack roll, it makes a Constitution saving throw (a creature with Blindsight or Immunity to the Blinded condition succeeds automatically). On a failure it has the Blinded condition until the end of the turn. On a success it must subtract 1d4 from the triggering attack roll. The target automatically succeeds on its saves against your later castings of this spell for 24 hours. Cantrip, no scaling.
